title: Choosing bottles & jars
intro: We start by understanding how you will fill, serve and present the honey.
items: Do you supply honey or empty packaging?

We supply empty bottles, jars and packaging components in bulk. The honey and decoration in our photographs show how the packaging can look in use; filling the finished pack remains with your operation.
Should I choose a squeeze bottle or a wide-mouth jar?

We normally start with the way your customer will use the honey. A dispensing bottle suits honey served through a cap, while a wide-mouth jar allows spoon access. We can send samples so you can try the opening, handling and your actual honey before ordering.
Does a 250 ml bottle hold 250 g of honey?

No. Milliliters measure volume, while grams measure weight. Our 250 ml bear bottle has an approximate 350 g reference honey fill, but you should confirm the final weight and headspace with your own honey and fill line.
Are the listed capacities nominal or brimful?

The volumes shown in our catalog are water capacities. Ask us for the dimensioned drawing if you need to confirm whether a figure is nominal or brimful, then use your honey to approve the working fill level and headspace.
Do the listed options differ in shape, size or closure?

Yes. Options can differ in capacity, body shape or closure even when they belong to the same product family. We recommend comparing each specification and checking an assembled sample before you order.

title: Caps, liners & dispensing
intro: We match the container and closure as one working assembly.
items: Can I reuse a cap I already buy?

Possibly. Send us the cap drawing or a physical sample together with the bottle you want to use. We will compare the full neck finish, sealing surface, liner and application method, because the apparent diameter alone cannot confirm a match.
Does every inverted bottle have a silicone valve?
No. A silicone valve is available only with certain closures. We will identify what is included in the proposed cap, and you should test the complete bottle-and-valve assembly with your honey.
Can I order bottles and caps separately?
Yes. Tell us how many bottles and caps you need and whether they should be packed separately or assembled. We will list the packing arrangement and any liner or seal in the quotation.
Are induction seals or tamper bands included?

Only when they are specified in the agreed assembly. Tell us which seal, liner or tamper-evident feature you need, and we will check it with the selected container; your filling team should also confirm it works with the equipment.
How should I assess dispensing and leakage?

We recommend testing the assembled bottle and closure with your honey under the intended filling, serving and transport conditions. Before production, we can agree with you how flow, reclosure and leakage will be checked for the order.

title: MOQ, samples & timing
intro: We confirm order terms after we know the model and customization you need.
items: What is the minimum order quantity?

MOQ depends on the container size, closure and decoration. You can find reference figures in our product specifications, and our team will confirm the current MOQ and availability for the exact pack you choose.
Can I request samples before a bulk order?
Yes. Send us the model references and tell us how you plan to use the pack. Before dispatch, we will confirm sample availability, any sample or customization charge and the courier arrangement.
Can I use my own courier account?
Yes. You can arrange collection with your own courier account. Once the sample parcel is ready, our team will give you the pickup details.
How long does production take?
We use 15–20 days as a general planning reference. The final lead time depends on the product, quantity, decoration, sample approval and our production schedule, so we confirm it in your quotation.
Can I place a small trial order?
Sometimes. Tell us the exact model and quantity so we can check stock, packing limits and any small-order charge. A trial quantity available for one product may not be available for another.

title: Labels, colors & custom development
intro: We develop the branding and custom details around the actual container and closure.
items: Can the label and cap color be customized?

Often, yes. Send us the selected pack, artwork, color references and quantity. We will explain which label, printing and cap-color options are available, together with the MOQ and any additional charge.
Can one label fit several sizes?

The visual design can stay consistent, but each bottle or jar needs its own label dimensions. Molded bear details, ribs, shoulders and corners change the usable area, so we check the artwork on every selected size.
Can you develop a new honey bottle shape?

Yes. We can start from your brief, sketch or reference sample and work through the drawing, prototype, tooling quotation and sample approval with you. We set out design rights and tooling terms separately.
How long does a custom project take?

We use 4–6 weeks as a general planning reference for development. New tooling, sample revisions, decoration and production quantity can change the timing, so we prepare a project schedule covering development, approval and production.
Can you supply mini jars for hospitality portions?

Yes. We can coordinate suitable jars, lids and outer packing through our supply partners. We will prepare the assembled jar, label size, insert and protective packing as one set for approval; decorations shown in photographs are not automatically included.

title: Materials, filling & documentation
intro: We help you find the available reports and filling information for the pack you select.
items: Do you manufacture glass as well as plastic?

We manufacture plastic bottles and caps, and we supply selected glass jars through our packaging partners. Tell us the target honey weight, jar model, lid finish, quantity and destination, and we will confirm the jar, matching lid, carton quantity and protective export packing.
Can I hot-fill honey into these PET bottles?

That depends on the exact bottle, closure and filling process. Share your filling temperature, holding time and cooling method with us so we can provide the available specifications; the complete assembly should then be tested in your process.
Which documents can I review?

Our Quality page contains the certificates and sample reports currently available for download. Tell us the proposed material, bottle or jar, closure and destination, and we will help identify the relevant documents. A report for one tested sample does not certify every model.
Do the PET and PP PPWR reports cover the whole package?

No. The reports cover the named PET and PP samples and the specified heavy-metal and total-fluorine tests. They do not certify every model or every PPWR requirement, so we match the report scope to the pack you are considering.
Can a recycled-material option be quoted?

Tell us the recycled-content target, appearance and destination, and we will check what can be offered and which food-contact documents are available for that material. Our standard PET listings do not state a recycled percentage.

title: Packing, shipping & quotation
intro: We quote the components, protective packing and delivery around your complete order.
items: What does the carton quantity include?

It depends on whether the order is packed as bottle bodies, separate caps or assembled units. Catalog quantities and weights are references; decoration, bags, dividers and separately packed closures can change the final packing list. We show the agreed arrangement in your quotation.
Can you arrange pallets or glass protection?

Yes. We can quote pallets and additional transit protection. For glass jars, we match the dividers and protective materials to the selected model; extra protection can increase shipment volume and freight cost.
Can goods go to another supplier for consolidation?
Yes. Send us the consolidation address, receiving contact, required arrival date and carton-marking instructions. We will include the available delivery arrangement and related cost in the quotation.
What should a complete quotation include?

Our quotation should clearly list the bottle or jar, cap, liner or seal, decoration, any tooling, packing and transport. It should also state the currency, quantity, delivery terms, payment schedule and validity so you can compare the options on the same basis.
Are your case studies all completed orders?

No. We say what stage each case reached. The bottle-and-cap sourcing enquiry remained at quotation stage, while the bear-bottle and mini-jar cases describe the product and export-packing decisions we completed with those customers.
